build_CogView4ControlModelSpecification: build a CogView4ControlModelSpecification instance to load and configure CogView4 control models with custom processors
create_load_diffusion_models: create diffusion models by loading the CogView4 transformer and scheduler with expanded input channels for control
test_prepare_latents: test preparing latents and control latents from images using the VAE encoder with optional posterior sampling
run_forward: run the forward pass of the CogView4 transformer with noisy latents, control latents, and text conditions
review_validation: review the validation method that generates images from a prompt and control image using the CogView4 pipeline
